args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18% following the latest deploy. In response, checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, across all regions. After the rollback, health checks passed and the error rate dropped to 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression remains to be investigated.

trace.final:
Task complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The latest release that had been healthy in production. (v2.3.1-rc showed healthy only in staging, so it didn't qualify.) The rollback rolled out successfully to all regions.

3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%, down from 18%.

4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action, and that on-call has been paged. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation.
